title: Cri loutre d'Asie au zoo de La Bourbansais
author: Abujoy
changes: Smooth-coated otter (Lutrogale perspicillata) calls, a close relative standing in for the sea otter (no free sea otter call recording was found). Trimmed to 2.30–4.15 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 300 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The high-pass is set to 300 Hz because the zoo recording has low rumble; the otter calls are above 2 kHz.
